title: Weekly SMS reminders to customers who owe you
summary: Every week, text each customer on your debtors sheet how much they still owe.
description: Once a week at the day and time you choose, reads your debtors list from a Google Sheet (columns: name, phone, amount_owed) and sends each customer who still owes money a polite SMS reminder with the amount and how to pay. Customers with nothing owed or no phone number are skipped. At most five messages go out at a time.

params.name: business_name
params.title: Business name
params.description: How your customers know you; it starts every message.

params.name: spreadsheet_id
params.title: Debtors spreadsheet
params.description: The spreadsheet's id, from its link (the long part between /d/ and /edit).

params.name: sheet_range
params.title: Sheet and columns
params.description: Where the list is, with a header row of name, phone and amount_owed.

params.name: day
params.title: Day
params.description: The day of the week the reminders go out.

params.name: send_time
params.title: Time
params.description: The time the reminders go out, Lagos time.

params.name: payment_details
params.title: How to pay
params.description: Added to each reminder, e.g. your account number and bank.

params.name: sms_connection
params.title: Termii connection
params.description: The name of your Termii connection.

params.name: sheets_connection
params.title: Google Sheets connection
params.description: The name of your Google Sheets connection.

definition.name: Weekly SMS reminders to customers who owe
definition.description: Texts every customer on the debtors sheet who still owes money.

steps.name: Use your business name and payment details
For each customer on the sheet
Text the customer a reminder of what they owe
steps.when: =has(item.phone) && item.phone != null && has(item.amount_owed) && item.amount_owed != null && double(item.amount_owed) > 0.0

input.sms: =steps.settings.output.business_name + ': Hello ' + (has(item.name) && item.name != null ? string(item.name) : 'there') + ', a friendly reminder that NGN ' + string(item.amount_owed) + ' is still outstanding. ' + steps.settings.output.payment_details
